don-pepin-garcia--don-pepin-garcia-origi.description: Don Pepín García's original blue-label cigar, made in Miami in its early years, is a Nicaraguan puro built around Pepín's signature spice. It moves from cedar, citrus and a hint of dark chocolate through a sweeter stretch of chocolate and caramel to pepper, earth and a long, leathery finish, with sweet spice slowly building.

thirds.notes: Pepín's spice shows on the retrohale, with cedar in front and touches of citrus and dark chocolate.
Sweeter: chocolate and caramel blend over woody notes as the citrus fades and earth appears.
Pepper returns, the smoke turns earthy with cedar, and the finish grows long and leathery.

sources.title: The Cigar Authority – Don Pepín García Original review
Stogie Review – Don Pepín García Blue Label

don-pepin-garcia--don-pepin-garcia-cuban.description: The Cuban Classic, part of Don Pepín García's original trio and known as his black label, is an all-Nicaraguan blend of Cuban-seed tobacco made by the García family in Estelí. Peppery and leathery at the start, it turns sweeter with butter and black cherry, then settles into coffee, dark chocolate, cedar and earth.

thirds.notes: Peppery spice with leather, unsweetened coffee and a hint of cocoa, and earth arriving late.
The pepper settles as black cherry, butter, caramel and light chocolate emerge, with nutty aromas.
Woodsy and earthy, with coffee, deeper cherry, dark chocolate and leather as the pepper fades.

sources.title: Stogie Press – Don Pepín García Cuban Classic Robusto review
Cigar Inspector – Don Pepín García Cuban Classic Robusto 1979

don-pepin-garcia--don-pepin-garcia-serie.description: Series JJ is a Don Pepín García Nicaraguan puro with a reddish Corojo Rosado wrapper over a Criollo binder and a Criollo and Corojo filler. Rich and earthy, it starts with sharp pepper, settles into earth and leather, and then climbs steadily in strength toward a spicy, leathery finish.

thirds.notes: Spice from the reddish wrapper and strong pepper up front, settling into a gentle, earthy smoke.
Corojo spice intensifies and the Criollo darkens; pepper gives way to earth and leather as the strength rises.
Toasted earth and spice merge over a leathery finish at the cigar's fullest strength.

sources.title: Klaro Cigars – Don Pepín García Series JJ Selecto review
JR Cigars – Don Pepín García Series JJ

don-pepin-garcia--don-pepin-garcia-vegas.description: Vegas Cubanas, known informally as the green label, predates My Father Cigars: Don Pepín García first made it at his El Rey de los Habanos factory in Miami's Little Havana. Now a Nicaraguan puro from the family's farms and factory, revamped in 2023, it is gentle and woody, with cherry-vanilla sweetness, earth and building black pepper.

thirds.notes: Earth and wood open, giving way to cherry-vanilla sweetness and natural tobacco, with black pepper late in the third.
Cherry-vanilla leads at first; past the midpoint wood and black pepper take over.
Wood and pepper dominate, balanced by lingering cherry-vanilla and a faint earthiness.

sources.title: Cigar Coop – Don Pepín García Vegas Cubanas Generosos (2023) review
Kohnhed – Don Pepín García Vegas Cubanas review

don-pepin-garcia--don-pepin-vintage-edit.description: Don Pepín Vintage Edition began in 2023 as a Tobacconists' Association of America exclusive for My Father Cigars' 20th anniversary and went national in 2024. A Nicaraguan puro with a Corojo '99 wrapper, made in Estelí, it nods to Pepín's early Miami cigars and smokes bright, with lemon, herbs, cedar and pepper over earth.

thirds.notes: Herbal and lemon notes lead, with cedar, cream and earth, and pepper building on the retrohale.
Lemon and herb stay in front over earth, cedar and pepper as the cream fades.
Lemon and herb remain, with pepper the strongest supporting note and a fuller body.
